messages:
Devon: Quick sync 1: how should the control plane surface deployment "intent" vs what adapters actually allocate for Hosted/Dedicated/Private?

Maria: keep intent declarative (e.g., slo_class: gold). Resolve into an immutable effective_profile at deploy time that records source of each field.

Jamal: adapters must publish clamps and a translate_intent endpoint. If missing, control plane provides a best-effort estimate and marks it as estimated.

Olivia: UX: Console shows requested vs effective with a one-line reason for any differences. Also allow tenants to lock keys (profile_lock) to prevent adapter changes.

Devon: failure mode: default is degraded=true with reason. For strict tenants allow fail_on_mismatch=true to block deploys.

Maria: implement as a profile-resolver service that merges global, tenant, adapter, then applies clamps. Emit profile_resolution event stored with the deploy record.

Jamal: compatibility: backfill active deployments with computed effective_profile and warn via linter for ad-hoc fields.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: will run canary after profile-resolver lands; notify #infra-smoke.

Olivia: security note: ensure network.egress and data_retention fields are honored by adapters and audited, especially for Private mode.

Devon: action items: Maria draft schema + RFC, Jamal prototype translate_intent, Olivia draft console diff wireframe. I'll file tracking ticket.
